entries.name: Divination Reroll
entries.desc: Grants +1 tablet draft reroll per working per rank.
entries.lore: Cast the astrolabe dice anew when the first tablets reveal only dross.

entries.name: Exorcism Banish
entries.desc: Grants +1 tablet banish per working per rank.
entries.lore: Strike an unwanted formula from the cycle so its taint never returns to the offer.

entries.name: Fixation Lock
entries.desc: Grants +1 tablet lock per working per rank.
entries.lore: Seal a prized tablet in wax to guarantee it appears in your next ascension draft.

entries.name: Distillation Attunement
entries.desc: +5% Essence gained from all sources per rank.
entries.lore: Finer alembic coils trap stray quintessence before it evaporates into the ash.

entries.name: Tonic Buffer
entries.desc: +15 Max HP for all vessels per rank.
entries.lore: Annealed clay walls and salt-tempered ribs harden the vessel before it descends.

entries.name: Bellows Valve
entries.desc: +12% overheat decay rate and -8% primary heat gain per rank.
entries.lore: Brass relief vents bleed excess furnace pressure between sustained volleys.

entries.name: Ascension Seals
entries.desc: Unlocks +1 Ascension Seal difficulty tier (+15% Essence reward per active seal).
entries.lore: Break successive hermetic seals at the Crucible to draw harsher trials and richer essence.
